name: Technique - Spectral sample gun
description: Standalone technique from the sample-to-gun checklist: tonal percussion into Serum 2 spectral, stacked overdrive, convolver, multiband and pitch bend.

manual.instruction: Put a sine sub on oscillator A. Switch oscillator B to spectral and load a tonal percussion sample such as a ride; pitch it down an octave.
manual.verify: The sample supplies a pitched metallic tone while the sine holds the low end.
manual.why: oddprophet's sample-to-gun method uses a sine sub and a spectral oscillator loaded with a tonal percussion sample.

manual.instruction: Stack two or more overdrives for crunch. Add a splitter and convolve only the high path with a medium plate impulse; set decay, gain and mix.
manual.verify: The top has body and space while the sub path stays dry.
manual.why: oddprophet stacks Serum 2 overdrives and convolves only the split high path.

manual.instruction: Distort after the splitter, compress with the multiband compressor, and use LFO 2 on global main tuning for short pitch bends.
manual.verify: The gun has a controlled transient and a repeatable pitch gesture.
manual.why: oddprophet adds post-splitter distortion, multiband compression and an LFO pitch bend.

manual.instruction: Use the scan knob for sample speed/direction, then route the spectral oscillator through a band-pass notch filter. Try different samples and warp modes.
manual.verify: The sample speaks as a gun rather than a pitched loop, and the recipe works with more than one source.
manual.why: oddprophet demonstrates scan, band-pass notch filtering and multiple source samples.

manual.instruction: Resample the result, replace or remove the sub if the source already has weight, and tidy stereo low end.
manual.verify: The printed gun is punchier than the source and mono-compatible.
manual.why: The tutorial treats this as a reusable sample-to-gun recipe; printing keeps the result stable.

notes: Source: oddprophet, 'SERUM 2: HOW TO TURN ANY SAMPLE INTO A HEAVY DUBSTEP BASS' (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LRQFCUXqXr4). Transcript summary, not quotes. Reference-only because Serum 2's spectral oscillator and effects cannot be created or verified by this engine.
